Name: Koganei Niko
Other Names: Niko, Nikotan, 虎金妃笑虎, ニコたん
Personality: Her official profile presents Niko as FLOW GLOW's jokester: so passionate about making people smile that she would give her whole life to it, and happy to bulldoze through a bit or break character as long as it ends in laughter. She is weak against mornings and soft on animals, yet hosts a Saturday-morning talk show. On stream she calls herself "Nikotan," swings from long mock-formal apologies to blunt, casual banter, laughs at herself first, and turns her own imagined life into anime-style comedy shorts that she labels as pure fantasy. She is warm with her fans, the Niko Stans, and with her unit, and loud and helpless in horror games when a senpai is watching.
Background: Niko is an active member of FLOW GLOW. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2024-11-09 through hololive DEV_IS as FLOW GLOW's jokester, with Isaki Riona, Mizumiya Su, Rindo Chihaya and Kikirara Vivi. Since 2024-11 she has posted over a hundred anime-style comedy shorts. FLOW GLOW held its 3D debut live on 2025-11-23, released its first album on 2026-01-21 and made its festival debut at hololive 7th fes. on 2026-03-07. Niko held a 3D "Niko Day" stream on 2026-02-05, named her Saturday-morning talk show 朝ガオ in June 2026 and released her first solo single, "星炎" (Seien), on 2026-07-26. She sang LYRA's "III" with Mori Calliope, Elizabeth Rose Bloodflame, Ayunda Risu and Amane Kanata, and "Magia" with Calli and Nerissa Ravencroft (2026-08-28).

Tiger stage outfit: a high ponytail, a black zip-up crop top with orange-patterned mesh sleeves and long black gloves, a studded tiger-head belt with chains and claw charms, and a torn khaki wrap over flowing black trousers printed with orange tiger stripes. Dialogue Style: Streams in Japanese: loose, fast and self-mocking, calling herself 「ニコたん」. She switches without warning between exaggerated formal apologies and blunt casual speech (「ほんまにごめん」, "really sorry"), throws herself into a bit and signs off with a chant, 「ニコたんが〜、帰宅〜！」 ("Nikotan is going ho~me!"). No regional accent is assigned. When a story renders her speech in English or Chinese, keep the comedian's timing, the third-person "Nikotan" and the sudden drops from pomp to bluntness.
Catchphrases: "If you can't bring yourself to a smile, just say my name!" (official English; 「笑えない時は、ニコたんの名を呼ぶがいいさ！」); 「ニコたんが来たァ!」 ("Nikotan's here!") and 「ニコたん参上！」 ("Nikotan has arrived!"); 「それでは、ニコたんが帰宅でよろしくお願いします」 then 「ニコたんが〜、帰宅〜！」 ("Nikotan is going ho~me!") and 「バイバ〜イ」 to sign off; 「ニコたん」 (herself); 「ニコ担」 ("Niko Stan," her fans, said the same way as her nickname).
